cardUpfront.title: Why We Ask for a Card Upfront
cardUpfront.description: We believe in full transparency. Here is why we require a card to start your free trial:

aiCosts.title: Real AI Costs
aiCosts.description: Every Jeeves conversation uses advanced AI that costs us real money. A card helps us provide unlimited access during your trial.

sustainability.title: Ministry Sustainability
sustainability.description: Phototheology is a ministry-driven platform. Your support helps us keep building and improving these tools for everyone.

noCharge.title: No Charge Until Day 8
noCharge.description: You will not be charged a single cent during your 7-day trial. Cancel anytime before it ends.

cancelAnytime.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancelAnytime.answer: Yes! You can cancel your subscription at any time from your account settings. If you cancel during your trial, you will not be charged at all.

paymentMethods.question: What payment methods do you accept?
paymentMethods.answer: We accept all major credit cards, debit cards, and some digital wallets through Stripe, our secure payment processor.

whyCard.question: Why is a card required for the free trial?
whyCard.answer: Our AI features have real costs per conversation. The card requirement helps us offer unlimited AI access during your trial while keeping the platform sustainable.

cantAfford.question: What if I cannot afford a subscription?
cantAfford.answerPrefix: We never want cost to be a barrier to Bible study.
cantAfford.answerSuffix: and we will work something out. We offer student discounts and hardship pricing.

studySuite.methodTrainingQuote: "The goal is not to know more about the Bible. The goal is to see what God embedded in every page."
studySuite.completePackageDescription: Three professionally crafted PDFs that take you from foundation to mastery of the Phototheology method.
studySuite.eightFloorsDescription: Each floor builds on the previous. Together they create a complete Bible study methodology that transforms how you read Scripture.

comparison.seoTitle: Why Phototheology? - Compare Bible Study Tools
comparison.seoDescription: See how Phototheology compares to Logos, Accordance, and ChatGPT for Bible study. Discover what makes our approach unique.
comparison.heroDescription: Phototheology is not a search engine for Scripture. It is a training system that teaches you how to study — with structure, guardrails, and AI that knows theology.
comparison.structuredFrameworkDescription: Unlike generic tools, every feature maps to the 8-floor Palace system — giving your study direction and progression.
comparison.theologicalGuardrailsDescription: Our AI (Jeeves) is trained within biblical boundaries. No hallucinated theology. No unguarded speculation.
comparison.activeLearningDescription: Earn XP, unlock rooms, compete in challenges, and build memory palaces. Study becomes something you look forward to.
comparison.whyNotChatgptDescription: Generic AI is powerful but dangerous for theology. Here is what Phototheology does differently.
comparison.noGuardrailsDesc: ChatGPT will generate any theology you ask for, including heresy
comparison.noFrameworkDesc: Answers questions but does not teach you how to study
comparison.hallucinatesDesc: Invents Bible verses and commentary sources that do not exist
comparison.noSanctuaryDesc: Has no understanding of typological or sanctuary-based interpretation
comparison.noProgressionDesc: Every conversation starts from zero — no memory, no growth tracking
comparison.jeevesTrainedDesc: Our AI operates within the Phototheology framework with built-in guardrails
comparison.palaceFrameworkDesc: Every response references the 8-floor system for structured learning
comparison.scriptureFirstDesc: Jeeves cites real verses and verified sources, not hallucinated ones
comparison.sanctuaryLensDesc: Every analysis considers typological and sanctuary-based connections
comparison.adaptsLevelDesc: Tracks your progress and challenges you at the right difficulty
comparison.whyNotTraditional: Why Not Just Use Logos or Accordance?
comparison.whyNotTraditionalDescription: Traditional Bible software is excellent for research — but it was not built to teach you a method.
comparison.strengthAcademic: Deep academic resources and scholarly commentaries
comparison.missingMethodology: No study methodology — tools without a framework
comparison.missingSteepCurve: Steep learning curve for new users
comparison.missingAi: No AI integration for interactive learning
comparison.missingTeaching: Does not teach you how to teach others
comparison.ptDifferenceDescription: Phototheology takes the depth of academic tools and wraps it in a structured, gamified, AI-powered learning system. You do not just access information — you develop competency.
comparison.noteUserMustKnow: User must already know the types
comparison.noteJeevesKnows: Jeeves knows all 8 floors and 38 rooms
comparison.noteFullWorkflow: Full workflow from text to PowerPoint
comparison.readyToExperienceDescription: Join thousands of Bible students who have transformed their study with Phototheology structured, AI-powered approach.
